# b64

```go
import "kelompok17/internal/b64"
```

Package b64 berisi encode dan decode Base64 standar \(RFC 4648, pakai padding\)

## Index

- [func Decode\(s string\) \(\[\]byte, error\)](<#Decode>)
- [func Encode\(data \[\]byte\) string](<#Encode>)


<a name="Decode"></a>
## func [Decode](<https://github.com/sbimasena/Tugas3_IF4020_17/blob/main/internal/b64/b64.go#L14>)

```go
func Decode(s string) ([]byte, error)
```

Decode mengubah s kembali ke byte. Gagal kalau s bukan Base64 yang valid atau tidak canonical, contohnya "QR==" atau ada spasi dan newline.

<details><summary>Example</summary>
<p>



```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"kelompok17/internal/b64"
)

func main() {
	data, err := b64.Decode("QQ==")
	fmt.Println(string(data), err)
	_, err = b64.Decode("QR==")
	fmt.Println(err)
}
```

#### Output

```
A <nil>
base64: invalid or non-canonical encoding
```

</p>
</details>
